text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: autoscaler ceiling hit for GPU pool `inference-prod-1` - max_nodes=48 (current=48). queue_depth=482, p95_processing=2.8s -> 12.4s, error_rate=3.6%. autoscaler attempted 3 scale actions in last 10m and failed due to node quota. See /incidents/1769999999 for details.

sarah (eng-sre oncall): i'm on it. confirming impact. queue shows steady growth, a bunch of long-running streaming requests. tagging infra. @omar can you check org quota and whether we can temporary bump pool limit? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

omar (eng-infra): seeing the alert. cloud quota for GPUs in region `us-west2` is at account hard limit — current utilization 98%. we have a request route to apply short-lived quota increase but needs approval from cloudops and takes ~10-30m. i'll start the request.

jen (eng-oncall): joining - i'm taking incident comms. sarah, can you post the quick diagnostics (pod counts, node list, queue head sample)?

sarah (eng-sre oncall): copying outputs

```
$ kubectl get pods -n inference-prod -l pool=inference-prod-1 -o wide
NAME                                 READY  STATUS   RESTARTS  NODE
inference-ggml-abc-0                 1/1    Running  0         node-48
inference-worker-xyz-5               1/1    Running  0         node-46
inference-worker-long-tail-1         0/1    CrashLoopBackoff  5   node-44
...

$ kubectl get nodes -l pool=inference-prod-1
node-41 Ready
...
node-48 Ready
(total 48 nodes)

# queue head sample (oldest requests):
- req s12345 user=acct-A model=redwood-4xl tokens=15000 started=00:52:34
- req s12346 user=acct-B model=redwood-chat-stream tokens=20000 started=00:51:10
- many batched embed jobs from acct-C
```

ryan (support): CS reporting 5 customers with timeouts in last 15m. two accounts seeing degraded latencies on interactive chat features. they escalated to cs-lead.

cs-lead: confirmed — three paying accounts impacted (acct-A, acct-D, acct-F). we put a holding message to customers and are tracking as P1. can we triage to partial degradation and start mitigations?

sarah (eng-sre oncall): immediate mitigations i'm activating now: 1) enable overflow routing to `inference-spot` pool for non-SLA traffic, 2) apply temporary throttling on large-batch jobs, 3) trigger model-fallback policy for streaming customers to `redwood-2xl` for interactive routes. doing commands now.

```
# routing change (internal CLI)
redwoodctl routing set --route /v1/chat --pool inference-spot --match "!sla_tier:enterprise" --reason "emergency overflow"

# throttle large-batch jobs via rate-limit config
redwoodctl quotas update --scope embeddings --max-concurrency 20 --note "temp throttle"
```

omar (eng-infra): cloudops request submitted (ticket: GCP-23456), asking +16 GPUs quota for us-west2 zone, request type: emergency. ETA ~20m if approved. meanwhile we can increase max_nodes in our autoscaler to 64 but terraform apply will need approval + run and might be blocked by quota at runtime. i can stage a manual override on the autoscaler controller for immediate trial — i need ops approval.

jen (eng-oncall): do the manual override. we'll coordinate rollback if anything odd. sarah, please add notes to incident doc and update customer-facing status. i'll own comms.

omar (eng-infra): doing manual override: patching controller to allow `max_nodes=64` (ephemeral).

```
# quick patch to controller
kubectl -n infra patch deploy/autoscaler-controller --type=json -p '[{"op": "replace", "path": "/spec/template/spec/containers/0/args/1", "value": "--max-nodes=64"}]'
```

ops-bot: deploy job started for autoscaler-controller patch. job id=job-8934.

incident-bot: :information_source: autoscaler controller patch applied to `inference-prod` at 1769990285 by omar. Note: this does not change cloud quota.

sarah (eng-sre oncall): after patch we saw 3 extra nodes requested but cloud returned RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED on allocate. nodes stayed at 48. queue is reducing slightly due to throttles but still high (queue_depth=310). p95 now ~7.1s.

omar (eng-infra): cloudops approved emergency quota +16 GPUs. provisioning starting. GCP ticket GCP-23456 updated. estimating nodes up by ~10 in next 8-12 minutes while instances spin up.

ryan (support): updating affected customers: acct-A and acct-D see improvements in polling but still intermittent timeouts, acct-F still impacted, telling them we're scaling up and routing fallbacks.

cs-lead: good. mark mitigation=partial, severity=P1 -> we should keep customers informed every 10m.

jen (eng-oncall): handing off active monitoring to @jen - i'm going to lunchtime but will be reachable if pager. sarah, please handoff incident ops to jen in 15m.

sarah (eng-sre oncall): ack. i'll keep the watch and annotate runbook steps. creating a follow-up ticket to revert throttles and routing after scale settles.

```
# action items written down in incident doc
- monitor GCP quota ticket GCP-23456 until nodes become Ready
- rollback autoscaler patch if unexpected behavior observed
- remove emergency routing once pool stable
- run post-incident cost analysis for emergency quota use
- create RFC to increase baseline pool capacity or implement proactive burst credit
```

omar (eng-infra): new nodes registering: node-49..node-58 coming up. cloud console shows successful allocation of +12 GPUs. autoscaler now able to reach 60 target, nodes scaling to 60.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: SUCCESS: pool `inference-prod-1` reached new node count=60 at 1769991720. queue_depth trending down to 46. p95_processing=1.4s.

ryan (support): CS updated customers; acct-A and acct-D report recovery, acct-F still validating but initial signs good.

cs-lead: move to monitoring state. please keep postmortem template filled and link when created.

jen (eng-oncall): taking monitoring shift. sarah, I'll ping if anything regresses. thanks team. :thumbsup:

sarah (eng-sre oncall): filing blameless postmortem, adding timeline and decision points. immediate follow-ups: 1) add synthetic alert to trigger earlier at 70% pool utilization, 2) add a playbook for manual autoscaler patch and a one-click runbook for quota emergency requests.

omar (eng-infra): i'll also open infra task to request permanent quota increase and to automate temporary quota requests with cloudops when spikes detected.

ops-bot: incident closed to "monitoring" at 1769992180. next steps: postmortem draft due in 48h.

jen (eng-oncall): closing thread for active mitigation. will re-open if regressions occur. thanks everyone. :sparkles:
